contexts.text: It was felt only as a pleasurable sensation in the swelling breast.
He then began to swell... like Atlas... The reason was that such men swell from their Knowledges...
So those who constitute the colon are swelled... as is the colon with wind.
a. (The Spirits of the moon) are swollen, and suppose themselves to be great...
Hypocrites inflicted pain on my gums... so that they swelled.
Their foot swelled not () = that the natural man was not injured by these afflictions.
(In profaners of this kind) the unclean effluvia which exhale from the waste matters in the body... cause a swelling of their breasts...
